exposure: Blood HCO3- at time of study
Mode of delivery (emergency Cesarean section vs vaginal)
outcome: Brain reduced scattering coefficient of near-infrared light (μs')
finding: Smaller brain μs', indicating potential brain injury, was correlated with smaller gestational age, requirement for mechanical ventilation, and higher blood HCO3- levels at the time of study.
mod_finding: Emergency Cesarean section was associated with smaller brain μs' in the univariate analysis but was not a significant predictor in the multivariate analysis.
